title.en: Denomination and Characteristics of the Coin

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denomination and characteristics of the coin to be issued on 25th May 1999 by the Board of Commissioners of Currency, Singapore, are as shown in the Schedule.
